description: Uva Provincial Council - Amendment to a Statute as "Statute for Paying Salaries and Allowances bearing No. 02. 0f 1990"
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of a provincial statute regarding the payment of salaries and allowances to council officials. It involves legal modifications to an existing act, which falls under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal amendments. While it mentions government positions (deputy chairman), it does not name specific individuals or detail their portfolio responsibilities, focusing instead on the legal provisions for compensation.
